title: GridSim v2 machine dynamic data (gridsim-dynamics/2)
description: F23 (October 2026): per-machine dynamic data for the RMS transient-stability study, in the v2 family. The file carries its own templates, in exactly the library template shape (kinds synchronousMachine, exciter, pss, governor; provenance on every template; controller slots naming the exciter, pss and governor templates), and binds machine templates to the case's generators. Rules the schema subset cannot express are enforced in code: the templates are checked together as one library (V2LibraryChecker: kind specs, units, ranges, unique id@rev, controller references resolving to non-placeholder templates of the slot's kind); each machine entry names exactly one generator (by name, or by bus with a unit index when the bus has more than one unit); a generator is bound at most once; the model-specific required parameters are present (MachineDynamicsLoader).

machine.title: Machine binding
machine.description: One generator of the case and the synchronousMachine template (id@rev) that describes it. Name the generator by its name, or by its bus (with unit, the 0-based index among that bus's units in case order, when the bus has more than one).
